test_image_adjustment_defaults_and_reset.title: Verify image adjustment defaults and reset to default

steps.expected: The IMAGE ADJUSTMENT page shows sliders for Sharpness, Brightness, Contrast, Saturation and Hue.
Apply, Cancel and Default buttons are shown.
The page stays on IMAGE ADJUSTMENT with no error.

test_exposure_and_daynight_defaults.title: Verify exposure and day/night settings defaults

steps.expected: The page shows Auto exposure and AE metering options.
The page shows the Auto, Day and Night mode options.
IR mode and an IR strength slider are present.

test_image_enhancement_and_backlight.title: Verify image enhancement mirror/flip, 3D NR, LDC, and backlight WDR

steps.expected: The page shows 3D noise reduction and LDC (lens distortion) controls, Mirror and Flip, and the note that changing mirror or flip resets the privacy mask.
The page shows the WDR setting.
The page shows Flickerless with the 60Hz option.

test_motion_detection_zones.title: Verify motion detection configuration and zones

steps.expected: The MOTION DETECTION CONFIGURATION page lists Motion area1 to Motion area4.

steps.action: Read the sensitivity of each area.
steps.expected: Each of the four areas shows the default sensitivity 70.
Apply and Cancel buttons are shown.

test_privacy_mask_configuration.title: Verify privacy mask configuration page and controls

steps.action: On the Setup page, open PRIVACY MASK.
steps.expected: The PRIVACY MASK CONFIGURATION page is shown with an Activation setting.
It lists several areas (Area1 and more).
Clear area, Apply and Cancel buttons are shown.

test_corridor_mode_options.title: Verify corridor mode warning and options without triggering reboot

steps.action: On the Setup page, open CORRIDOR SETTING.
steps.expected: The page shows the options Off, 90 and 270.

steps.action: Read the note on the page.
steps.expected: It warns that applying a change reboots the camera. Do not click Apply.

test_smart_stream_disabled.title: Verify the Smart Stream page shows its configuration fields

steps.action: On the Setup page, open SMART STREAM.
steps.expected: The SMART STREAM page shows the fields Frame rate, GOP, Bitrate mode, Target bitrate, Hold on time and Trigger event.

test_roi_configuration.title: Verify Region of Interest configuration page

steps.action: On the Setup page, open ROI.
steps.expected: The REGION OF INTEREST CONFIGURATION page shows Stream, Activation and Quality settings.

test_white_balance_modes.title: Verify white balance configuration and modes

steps.expected: The WHITE BALANCE page shows Activation and White balance mode settings.
R Gain, G Gain and B Gain are present.

steps.action: Open the White balance mode dropdown.
steps.expected: It offers Auto and Manual.
